title: This hiring trick saved me 6 figures in bad hires
description: This hiring trick saved me 6 figures in bad hires
transcript: When I hired a senior director of operations, I had never hired for that position before so all I did was I did 40 interviews and I said what makes for a good chief marketing officer or what are your typical roles and responsibilities? And then after interviewing 40 people you have an idea of like what the good ones do and what the bad and I'm like, what's your No. 1 KPI as a senior director of operations? And then eventually after like the 15th one, you can start kind of coming into the meetings a little more prepared than the person you're interviewing and you also can get an idea of comp plans at the end of my first interview for everybody, I always ask what would you like your on track earnings to be? I didn't know in our industry what you pay a CMO, what do you pay a senior operations? After you interview 40 people, you get a range and you also look at your payroll budget based on what you have in your board here and you decide to do that the short answer of it is that a good appointment center is gonna be where you're gonna say, hey, I don't know what a good appointment center is I have a database where I'm getting 10 new leads every single day. I have no technology or no SOP set up what would you do in order to start booking appointments this week? See What they say.
